query:
SELECT l.id, l.lesson_number, l.title, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_vocabulary WHERE lesson_id = l.id) as vocab_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_chunks WHERE lesson_id = l.id) as chunks_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_examples WHERE lesson_id = l.id) as examples_count
FROM lessons l 
WHERE l.lesson_number IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) AND l.book_id = 5
ORDER BY l.lesson_number;
